bounded_host_request.command:
set -eu
cid=$(docker ps --filter label=com.docker.compose.service=videobot-poll --format '{{.ID}}')
if [ -z "$cid" ] || [ "$(printf '%s\n' "$cid" | wc -l)" -ne 1 ]; then printf 'SINGLE_POLLER_NOT_CONFIRMED\n'; exit 72; fi
docker inspect --format 'running={{.State.Running}} restart_count={{.RestartCount}} started={{.State.StartedAt}} image={{.Config.Image}}' "$cid"
docker logs --since 24h --tail 20000 "$cid" 2>&1 | awk '/^CREATOR_OWNER_JOB_NEEDS_RECONCILE=YES$/ {unknown++} /^CREATOR_DM_UPDATES_HANDLED=[0-9]+$/ {split($0,a,"=");accepted+=a[2]} /^CREATOR_UPDATES_QUARANTINED=[0-9]+$/ {split($0,a,"=");quarantined+=a[2]} /^CREATOR_POLL_RUNTIME_FAILED$/ {failed++} /^CREATOR_DM_POLL_READY=PASS$/ {ready++} END {printf "owner_job_unknown=%d accepted=%d quarantined=%d runtime_failed=%d ready=%d\n",unknown,accepted,quarantined,failed,ready}'
